notes.title: Demo Update V2.10
notes.content:
Dwarfs Descent – Demo V2.10

Game Updates
Removed Caved-In Spawn X Decal
Decal removed from spawn area.
[hr][/hr]Gameplay / Level Design
Random Start Cave Spawn Adjustment
Moved random start cave spawns slightly to the right to reduce lantern clipping.

Starting Rubble Quest Spawn Timing
Spawned the starting rubble quest earlier to avoid visibility issues when the player can already see the area.

Mine Exit Sign Overhaul
Replaced existing signs with text-based ones
[hr][/hr]Bugs & Fixes
Arrow Clipping Issue
Fixed arrows getting stuck in destructible boxes after breaking.

Radiation Microwave Effects on Arrows
Radiation microwave effects no longer interfere with arrow flight.

Entrance/Exit Darken Planes Lighting
Fixed lighting issues on darken planes for entrance/exit.

Bow String Mesh Issue
Fixed issue where two meshes were being used for the bow string.
[hr][/hr]Visual & FX Updates
Cave-In Particle Effect
Added new particle effect for when a cave-in hits the ground.
[hr][/hr]UI / HUD Updates
Updated Main Menu
New mine exit signs now featured in the main menu.

notes.title: Demo update V2.08
notes.content:
Dwarfs Descent – Demo V2.08


Animation & Movement:

Increased character sidestep play rate to reduce sliding.

Slightly increased visibility of footstep decals.

Reworked skeleton walk animations.

Updated spider animations with more bounce and dynamic motion.

Replaced spear and shotgun walk cycles with new walk and run animations.

Audio & Dialogue:

Reduced frequency of random speech triggers: changed from every 2–6 seconds to every 10–30 seconds.

Visual Effects:

Loot trail effects now properly recycle, improving performance and consistency.

Quests:

Fixed bug with the pickaxe starter quest: quest no longer completes if the player doesn't actually pick up the item.

Items:

Updated Pickaxe Name and Description.

Updated Dynamite Description.

notes.title: Demo Update V2.06
notes.content:
Dwarfs Descent – Demo Update V2.06


ChangelogNew Features
Achievements Menu: Added a dedicated achievements menu.

Mercenary Allies: Added mercenary Dwarfs. Pay them to assist you through the current level.

Points of Interest: Added 4 new Points of Interest:

2 include 1 Dragon Egg each.

2 include 1 Mercenary Dwarf each.

Spinach/Shop Quest:

Added more text.

Player now drops spinach and vendor picks it up.

Options: Added inverted axis options.

Dragon Eggs: spawned by Dragon Boss now automatically hatch.
[hr][/hr]Combat and AI Changes
Dragon Egg:

Cast time increased from 5s → 15s.

Health reduced: 2000 → 750.

Dragon Whelp:

Damage reduced: 150 Pierce + 150 Slash → 150 Pierce only.

Dragon: Charge move charge time increased: 1.5s → 5s.

Graverobber AI:

Now wears blue shirts to differentiate from Friendlys.

No longer gets aggroed by campfires or bat damage.

Wandering Neutral AI: Vision changed to full 360° awareness.

Skeletons:

Can now walk through spike traps, Instead of completely avoiding them.

Added Empty Grave mesh visuals for skeleton graves.
[hr][/hr]Weapons and Items
Simple Sword: Fixed bug with charge mechanics.

Shotgun:

Range increased: 600 → 1000.

Shot quantity increased: 3 → 5.

Pistol: Range increased from 1000 → 1500.

Vendor Items:

Fixed issue with item pickup radius (sphere moved up).

Vendor lantern projectile now uses correct fire sound.

Improved lantern attack animation.
[hr][/hr]User Interface & Visuals
Quest Marker: Increased scale and better rotation handling at top of screen.

Low HP Bar: Updated flashing behavior.

Floor Spikes: Made more noticeable with sparkle effects and texture update.

Coin Bag: Fixed description typo ("coing" → "coin").

How To Play: Brightened tutorial images for better visibility.

Fixed issue where Dragon Charge move effect visual was not always visible.
[hr][/hr]Audio Adjustments
Reduced:

Talking sounds.

Damage sounds.

No longer plays quest sounds on level start.
[hr][/hr]Loot & Drop Systems
Loot Spawning:

Updated spawn rates for super rare items:

Chaos Gem: 0.01% → 0.1%

Red Cloak: 0.01% → 0.1%

Scouter: 0.1% → 1%

Monolith Bone Quest:

Prevents bones from being picked back up.

Spammed loot is now properly destroyed using a tracked array system.
[hr][/hr]Bug Fixes
Dwarf Shop Gold:

Buying dwarfs and rerolls now correctly deduct gold.

Fixed gold amount inconsistency on level change.

Projectile Hitbox: Fixed projectile collisions at campfires.

Spider Dialogue:

Fixed issue where spider shows ". . ." if dialogue is off-screen.

Movement Issues:

Increased run interaction while running and not moving.

AI Controllers: Cleaned up faster on character death.

Vendor Item Bugs: Fixed item pickup range due to collider issues.

Merc Dwarf Pathing:

Known issue: mercenary dwarfs may stop following.

Temp fix: bring enemy near dwarf to re-engage.
